decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is far from the core business and only mentioned on the website, but a product line with several models represents a substantial engineering and certification investment tied to long naval procurement cycles, so weak early results can be blamed on temporary causes and management is likely to persist.

The medical examination light builds on established lighting competence and has its own page, a visible public commitment that fits the announced LED direction, so management will keep it despite any modest uptake.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires are a multi-model line with costly certifications, central to the firm's industrial customer base and LED strategy, which makes dropping them very unlikely.

The designer task light is close to the core offer, needs few dedicated resources and is publicly presented on its own page, so management will keep it and attribute slow sales to the early market phase.
